name: @afora/mcp
description: An MCP server that lets an agent discover the afora catalog, edit afora.json, validate it, generate the code and check the result.
author: Alan Reis <alanreisanjo@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Hoyasumii)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/bin.ts ./src/extract-child.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --packages external --tsconfig-override tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/add-dts-extensions.ts dist
